Manifest.Name: 原版枪械拓展 Vanilla Gun Expansion
Manifest.Author: KlN
Manifest.Description: 这个模组给枪械师多添了几笔生意，从金属锭到成品枪都能自己做。框架、改装件和弹药都能用芯片打印，子弹要先印弹壳，再按克装火药。打印机加了芯片库，也能超频，还能从枪械师储藏区自动取料、自动入库。新的枪柜最多能放九把枪。街头冲突会流出战损枪，经历攒够了的枪会成为名枪。四家公司还各出了两把新枪。枪能喷涂装、贴贴纸。打烊以后还能经营一家地下靶场，每到周六晚上还有联赛。另外还有一段剧情小分支“隐秘行动”。大部分功能都能在设置里单独关掉。卸载或停用前，先清空芯片库和枪柜，把靶场里的东西拿回来，等租出去的枪都还回来，再腾空储藏区多扩出来的几行。开过金属锭配方的，先关掉，读档后再存一次档。 / This mod brings the gunsmith more business, from metal ingots all the way to finished guns. Frames, gun mods and ammo can all be printed from chips, and for ammo you print the cases first and then load the powder by the gram. Printers get a chip rack and can overclock, and they can take materials from your gunsmith storage bays and stock finished pieces there. A new gun cabinet holds up to nine guns. Street clashes leave war-damaged guns behind, and a gun with enough history becomes famous. Four companies also bring two new guns each. Guns can take paint and stickers. After closing you can run an underground range, with a league on Saturday nights. There's also a side story, Covert Operation. Most features can be switched off on their own. Before uninstalling or disabling, empty the chip racks and gun cabinets, bring everything home from the range, wait for rented guns to come back and clear the bay's extra rows. If you turned on the ingot recipes, turn them off, then load and save once.
